title: Geoff Britton joins Wings | 1974
content:
Geoff Britton was invited to join Wings on 16 May 1974.

Britton was initially one of 52 drummers to take part in two days of auditions on 29 and 30 April. He then joined a shortlist of five players who were again auditioned on 8 and 9 May.

The final two were Britton and Rob Townsend. Britton spent 13 May playing with Wings at London’s Electric Ballroom. Evidently happy with his playing and personality, on this day Paul McCartney called Britton to tell him he had the job, completing the line-up of Wings mark II.

Page last updated: 12 December 2025
